stemMd: Which Boolean expression is equivalent to NOT(P AND Q) for all truth values of P and Q?
explanationMd: A conjunction fails whenever at least one operand is false. De Morgan's law therefore changes AND to OR while negating both operands; a truth table verifies all four cases.

distractorRationale.c: This is true only when both are false, which is too restrictive.
distractorRationale.b: This omits the case where P is false.
distractorRationale.e: This negates a different compound statement.
distractorRationale.a: This differs when both are true or both false.
